title: The Hand Raised for the Short Poem
youtube_title: The Hand Raised for the Short Poem | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A shy try, done kindly, is already courage.
summary: At a lantern walk along the evening lane, Dori feels shy about a hand that could go up for a four-line poem. Instead of pretending not to care, Dori tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Nana Ruth stays kind and does not push for a show.
